source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps the troubling repeated sexual metaphor and the children within the command; leaves the woman's prior circumstances unspecified.
Preserves the explicit “to him,” absent from the following births, without drawing a paternity inference.
Takes the difficult final bearing-away clause as refusal of pardon in the preceding negative scope; records its alternative in the note.
Preserves the open “I will not be for you” instead of adding “your God” to the verse.
Marks the abrupt reversal with yet; retains the place, sand, and children images across the Hebrew chapter boundary.
Keeps coming up from the land unresolved rather than importing a particular exile; retains the Jezreel reversal.
